name: browser-use
headline: MCP Link - AI Agent Tool Integration
short_description: MCP Link enables AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude to use approved local or remote tools via a browser extension and optional MCP server. It benefits operations teams by automating workflows, integrating with existing tools, and enhancing productivity.
author: AuraFriday

sections.overview:
MCP Link is a framework that connects AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT to real-world tools through a browser extension and optional MCP server. It uses the Model Context Protocol to let AI models discover and call tools you've explicitly approved, with full user control and logging of every action. The system supports both remote tools hosted online and local tools running on your machine, with optional sandboxing via Docker. Built for operations teams and enterprises, MCP Link provides enterprise-grade trust through tool-level permissions, user approval prompts, and complete audit trails. Installation is straightforward: load the extension manually in Chrome, add your MCP server, then visit supported AI sites where the extension automatically handles tool integration.
ChatGPT automating file operations and folder management on your local machine
Claude executing semantic SQL queries against approved databases
Gemini booking hotels or making reservations through approved services
Operations teams automating workflows across multiple approved tools with full audit logging
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/AuraFriday/mcp-link`
sections.usage:
```
Act as an AI agent using MCP Link to automate a workflow for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Use the following approved tools: [TOOL1], [TOOL2], and [TOOL3]. The goal is to [SPECIFIC TASK]. Provide a step-by-step plan and execute the actions through MCP Link.
```

```
# Workflow Automation Plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] Sector
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
